The Hardened Sand Wall , Hardened Ebonsand Wall , Hardened Crimsand Wall , and Hardened Pearlsand Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground Desert , considered unsafe . Underground Deserts generate by default the normal Hardened Sand Wall which may be converted into the respective variant if exposed to the Corruption , Crimson , or Hallow . Converted Hardened Sand Walls may further spread conversion; see Biome spread for more information. Unsafe Hardened Sand Walls do not drop as items when destroyed, and can only be obtained via crafting. They are considered safe walls when placed by the player.

Ice Blocks are a common block type found alongside Snow Blocks in the Snow and Ice biomes . They can be mined with a pickaxe or drill . Ice Blocks have low friction, causing a player walking over them to slide when stopping or changing directions. This effect can be mitigated by equipping Ice Skates or other accessories crafted from them.

Sand Blocks are soil blocks found in vast quantities in Desert biomes , at shore and bottom of Ocean biomes, and can be found as microbiomes in patches in the Underground layer. They are also shot as projectiles by Antlions . Sand can spread and be converted by the evil biomes and The Hallow (see below ).

Sandstone Blocks are blocks found naturally placed in the Underground Desert biome . Like Sand and Hardened Sand , they are corruptable blocks in Hardmode, and have Corruption , Crimson , and Hallowed counterparts: Ebonsandstone , Crimsandstone , and Pearlsandstone respectively.

The Sandstone Wall , Ebonsandstone Wall , Crimsandstone Wall , and Pearlsandstone Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground Desert , considered unsafe . Underground Deserts generate by default the normal Sandstone Sand Wall which may be converted into the respective variant if exposed to the Corruption , Crimson , or Hallow . Converted Sandstone Walls may further spread conversion to other walls; see Biome spread for more information. Unsafe Sandstone Walls do not drop as items when destroyed, and can only be obtained via crafting. They are considered safe walls when placed by the player.
The Scorpion and Black Scorpion are harmless critters that are most commonly found in a Desert . For detailed spawning conditions, see Notes .
The Encumbering Stone has a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being found in Sandstone Chests in the Underground Desert .

Wood is a type of block that is generally obtained by cutting down trees using an axe or a chainsaw . Regular Wood can be harvested from Forest trees , vanity trees , Living Trees , and Underground Cabins in underground or cavern layers, as well as by using the Faecorn . Forest trees can be cultivated by placing Acorns on top of regular grass or Mowed grass above surface , and vanity trees can be cultivated by placing Sakura Sapling or Yellow Willow Sapling on top of any grass (but yields Ebonwood or Shadewood instead if placed on Corrupt or Crimson grass variants).

Some Wood types are found placed in other forms. For example, Underground Cabins generally use Wood corresponding to their biome (i.e. Rich Mahogany in the Jungle, Boreal in the Snow biome, regular Wood basically everywhere else). Living Trees and Living Mahogany Trees are made of Living Wood and Rich Mahogany, respectively.
